## Pre-Workshop Checklist (4-6 Weeks Before)

- [ ] Topic and learning objectives defined
- [ ] Target audience identified
- [ ] Date, time, and location confirmed
- [ ] Co-facilitators recruited (if needed)
- [ ] Venue reservation confirmed
- [ ] Room setup needs identified (tables, chairs, A/V equipment)
- [ ] Registration system set up (if required)
- [ ] Promotional materials created
- [ ] Event description written

## Promotion Checklist (2-4 Weeks Before)

- [ ] Posted to community calendar
- [ ] Shared on social media
- [ ] Sent to school newsletter/email list
- [ ] Flyers posted in community (library, community center, etc.)
- [ ] Partner organizations notified
- [ ] Local media notified (if appropriate)
- [ ] Reminder sent to past participants

## Preparation Checklist (1-2 Weeks Before)

- [ ] Presentation slides finalized
- [ ] Activities and exercises planned
- [ ] Handouts designed and printed (quantity: _____)
- [ ] Materials gathered (pens, paper, name tags, etc.)
- [ ] Technology tested (projector, internet, audio)
- [ ] Backup plans prepared (tech failure, low attendance)
- [ ] Sign-in sheet prepared
- [ ] Feedback forms printed
- [ ] Final reminder sent to participants

## Workshop Agenda Template

**Introduction (10-15 minutes)**
- Welcome and introductions
- Ice breaker or opening activity
- Overview of workshop objectives
- Ground rules and expectations

**Content Delivery (30-60 minutes)**
- Main presentation/discussion
- Key points to cover:
  1. _________________________________
  2. _________________________________
  3. _________________________________
  4. _________________________________

**Interactive Activity (15-30 minutes)**
- Activity description: _________________________________
- Materials needed: _________________________________
- Debrief questions: _________________________________

**Discussion/Q&A (15-20 minutes)**
- Open discussion
- Address questions
- Share experiences

**Wrap-Up (5-10 minutes)**
- Recap key takeaways
- Share resources and next steps
- Feedback forms
- Thank participants

## Day-Of Checklist

**Setup (arrive 30-60 minutes early)**
- [ ] Room arranged appropriately
- [ ] Sign-in table set up
- [ ] Name tags and materials ready
- [ ] Technology set up and tested
- [ ] Handouts and resources displayed
- [ ] Welcome sign or directional signs posted
- [ ] Room temperature comfortable
- [ ] Water/refreshments set up

**During Workshop**
- [ ] Greet participants warmly
- [ ] Start on time
- [ ] Facilitate inclusive discussion
- [ ] Manage time effectively
- [ ] Be flexible and responsive to needs
- [ ] Take photos (with permission)

**Wrap-Up**

- [ ] Share resources and contact information
- [ ] Thank participants and co-facilitators
- [ ] Clean up space
- [ ] Collect materials and equipment

## Post-Workshop Checklist

**Immediate Follow-Up (Within 24 Hours)**
- [ ] Send thank you email to participants
- [ ] Share promised resources or information
- [ ] Respond to any urgent questions
- [ ] Download photos/materials from event

**Within One Week**
- [ ] Review feedback forms
- [ ] Follow up with individuals who requested it
- [ ] Report activity to program coordinator
- [ ] Share highlights on social media (with permission)
- [ ] Thank co-facilitators and helpers
- [ ] Return borrowed equipment/materials

**Reflection (Within Two Weeks)**
- [ ] Review what went well
- [ ] Identify areas for improvement
- [ ] Update materials based on feedback
- [ ] Plan next workshop if applicable
- [ ] Share learnings with other ambassadors

## Tips for Success

### Before the Workshop
1. Know your content but be flexible
2. Prepare more than you think you'll need
3. Have backup plans for technology
4. Arrive early to troubleshoot
5. Take care of yourself (rest, eat, hydrate)

### During the Workshop
1. Start and end on time
2. Create a welcoming atmosphere
3. Encourage participation from everyone
4. Be authentic and share experiences
5. Stay calm if things don't go as planned
6. Listen more than you talk
7. Validate all concerns and questions

### After the Workshop
1. Follow through on all promises
2. Respond to questions promptly
3. Use feedback to improve
4. Celebrate your success
5. Take time to rest and recharge
